title: Swift pod not found — pod install not run after adding a package
issue: iOS build fails: the Swift pod RNGestureHandler could not be found — did you run pod install?
log:
Analyzing dependencies
[!] CocoaPods could not find compatible versions for pod "RNGestureHandler":
  In Podfile:
    RNGestureHandler (from `../node_modules/react-native-gesture-handler`)

[!] The Swift pod `RNGestureHandler` could not be found in project ios/Podfile

broken.ios/Podfile:
require_relative '../node_modules/react-native/scripts/react_native_pods'
require_relative '../node_modules/@react-native-community/cli-platform-ios/native_modules'

platform :ios, '13.4'

target 'rn-bench-app' do
  config = use_native_modules!
  use_react_native!(
    :path => config[:reactNativePath],
    :hermes_enabled => true
  )
end

healthy.ios/Podfile:
require_relative '../node_modules/react-native/scripts/react_native_pods'
require_relative '../node_modules/@react-native-community/cli-platform-ios/native_modules'

platform :ios, '13.4'

target 'rn-bench-app' do
  config = use_native_modules!
  use_react_native!(
    :path => config[:reactNativePath],
    :hermes_enabled => true
  )
  pod 'RNGestureHandler', :path => '../node_modules/react-native-gesture-handler'
end
